note: Built-in screening reason-code dictionary shipped with the package. When the materials carry a code book of their own, that one takes precedence and this file is the fallback.

IN-INT.label: include
IN-INT.en: intervention or exposure matches the review question

EX-POP.label: exclude
EX-POP.en: population out of scope, for example animal or in-vitro work

EX-INT.label: exclude
EX-INT.en: intervention or exposure out of scope

EX-DES.label: exclude
EX-DES.en: ineligible design such as a review, editorial or case report

EX-DUP.label: exclude
EX-DUP.en: another copy of a study already represented by a kept record

EX-DATE.label: exclude
EX-DATE.en: publication date outside the search window

EX-SETTING.label: exclude
EX-SETTING.en: setting or country type out of scope

EX-FULLTEXT.label: exclude
EX-FULLTEXT.en: full text unavailable and the protocol treats it as excluded

P-ABS.label: needs_review
P-ABS.en: abstract missing or insufficient, full text required
